jobs.title: Geschäftsführer (m/w/d) – Skalierung & Automatisierung im Handwerk
jobs.description: Standort: Umkreis Lüneburg | Start: idealerweise ab März 2027 | Art: Vollzeit (On-Site) Wer wir sind & wo wir stehen: Kein “gemachtes Nest”, sondern eine echte Aufbau-Challenge Wir sind ein Handwerksunternehmen mit Herz und Technologie. Seit 10 Jahren reinigen und beschichten wir Dächer in Nord- und Mitteldeutschland. Unser Fundament: 4 Mio. € Umsatz, 30 Mitarbeitende und ein CRM mit 8.000 Kunden (darunter 500 B2B-Hausverwaltungen). Jetzt zünden wir die nächste Stufe und investieren massiv: Wir haben ein brandneues, doppelt so großes Gebäude bezogen, neue Köpfe in Sales, Marketing sowie Backoffice eingestellt und bauen unsere KI-gestützte Prozessautomatisierung weiter aus. Die ehrliche Realität: Wir stecken mitten im Umbruch. Wir sind kein fertiger Konzern, bei dem alles von alleine läuft. Der Gründer hat den Grundstein gelegt und widmet sich nach einer Übergabe- und Einarbeitungsphase neuen Projekten. Jetzt suchen wir einen Macher (m/w/d), der aktiv anpackt, um unsere Teams und Strukturen zu festigen und das hohe Marktpotenzial voll auszuschöpfen. Deine Mission bei uns: Gesamtverantwortung übernehmen: Du übernimmst nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung die volle kaufmännische, strategische und operative Führung vom Inhaber, damit dieser sich aus dem Tagesgeschäft zurückziehen kann. Strukturen festigen & Team führen: Du bist der Taktgeber für unser Büro und unsere Monteure auf dem Dach. Du steuerst das Tagesgeschäft, packst aktiv beim Recruiting an und sorgst für echten Teamgeis

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Simulation (Digital Twins)
jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. The Role You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill. You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator. jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
jobs.description:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

jobs.description:

Location: Maastricht, Aachen, and Eindhoven region, working mainly on-site with our development partner in Maastricht. Regular travel to Hamburg and to clinical sites, about 2 to 4 days per month.

Reports to: CTO

About the venture: ROB'E

ROB'E is a Hamburg-based medtech startup and part of the NLC Health Ventures portfolio. We are developing a robotic system that holds and steers a standard transesophageal echocardiography (TEE) probe during structural heart interventions. Interventionalists get stable, reproducible echo views, and echocardiographers no longer have to stand next to the patient in the X-ray field.

Our first-generation prototype has been used in a first-in-human study with published results. We are now developing the next generation from scratch as a fully compliant medical device for CE marking and FDA clearance. The team includes a CTO, a System Software Architect and a Head of Quality & Regulatory.

The role

You are the mechatronic design authority of ROB'E. You own the system architecture, the hardware requirements and the technical decisions for the mechanics, drives, sensing and electronics of our robot.
